build_note: 2026-10-12 build: all nine claims moved to supported / checked on the shipped test evidence (tests/test_spec011.py, 25 tests; full suite 274 passed, 2 skipped — the 249-test pre-change baseline plus the 25 new, no regressions). Backward compatibility was measured, not asserted: the eight frozen bundles were verified with the pre-change code first and their verdicts pinned, then re-verified under the new code. Stage is checked throughout (author's own tests; DN-010 convention) — no claim is explained or accepted, and none of the eight frozen artifacts was modified.
